text_block_list.text:
One day, as the Fan Appreciation Festival 
draws near.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A photo session?

text_block_list.name: Fan Appreciation Festival Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's the main event of the Fan 
Appreciation Festival! We'd absolutely 
love it if you could participate, Agnes 
Tachyon-san!

She explains that the committee selects 
Umamusume from across the academy and goes 
around scouting them like this.

text_block_list.name: Fan Appreciation Festival Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
We'll be on a rotation, so your shift is 
only one hour! Plus, you'll get plenty of 
time to interact with all the fans!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see, I see.

The committee member wore a face full of 
anticipation, but... Agnes Tachyon hated 
nothing more than wasted time.
choice_data_list:
(They're probably going to turn it 
down...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Very well, how fascinating! I shall gladly 
accept your photoshoot!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What's with the "Huh?!" "Huh?!" yourself.

—And so, in a surprising turn of events, 
Agnes Tachyon ended up participating in a 
photo session at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival.

It piqued my curiosity so much that after 
the executive committee members left, I 
asked her the reason, and—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I've recently 
developed quite an interest in the power 
generated by "enthusiasm" and "passion."

It was surprising that Agnes Tachyon, a 
lover of science, would show interest in 
something spiritual.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I simply sensed the potential from 
personal experience, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's been proven that muscle exertion is 
linked not only to physiological 
conditions, but also psychological 
ones—namely the activity levels of the 
cerebral cortex and central nervous 
system!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The significance of cheers from others 
varies with fluctuations in psychological 
state. While a notable effect is 
recognized in adolescent girls—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I wondered whether the same could really 
be said for Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well... to put it casually, I just thought 
I'd deepen my bond with my "fans."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For the sake of research, of course.

In the end, Agnes Tachyon was still Agnes 
Tachyon through and through...

And then came the day of the Fan 
Appreciation Festival.

A huge crowd of fans, rapidly growing 
after being captivated by her in the Osaka 
Hai, had swarmed the photo session.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai was incredible! I'll keep 
cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Awesome! The real deal! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well now, that is an honor! Hahaha!

Even though I knew it was for the sake of 
the experiment, the unfamiliar sight 
completely captivated me.

――Eventually, the photo shoot came to an 
end――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew! I'm a bit tuckered out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that made for some excellent 
observation. Opportunities like this don't 
come around often, after all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Changes in respiration, pulse, pupil 
dilation...! While there were 
individual—er, specimen—differences, it 
was observed in everyone!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems they consider me their "reward." 
Hehehe, how delightful. I look forward to 
what's to come.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've gained another fine guinea pig. 
Quite a harvest!

While dumbfounded by her sheer, unwavering 
consistency...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Rest assured. You are my number one 
guinea pig.

Agnes Tachyon showed some consideration 
for me.

—Whatever the case, the Fan Thanksgiving 
experience seemed to have been a great 
inspiration to her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! Man, that was way more work than 
I thought!
choice_data_list:
You looked like you were having fun, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Was that so? Ah, I suppose I got overly 
excited with more guinea pigs around.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not often you get a chance 
to observe someone whose emotions are 
leaking out so clearly up close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Changes in respiration and heart rate were 
observed upon visually perceiving me. It 
appears the dopaminergic nervous system is 
being stimulated.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The more I win, the more their reward 
systems will be stimulated. Some might 
even weep just from looking at me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... My my, how fascinating. These 
"fans", that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was an unfamiliar situation, but it 
wasn't as bad as I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... to use an intuitive 
phrase, they were, in every sense of the 
word, totally fluffy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In any case, it wasn't unpleasant. If 
anything, it was rather amusing.

Though it went slightly off-script, she 
seemed to have enjoyed the photo shoot in 
her own way.

...And with that, she suddenly burst out 
laughing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh! Ah, I see! When you gaze into 
the abyss, the abyss also... That sort of 
thing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, well... it's merely a hypothesis, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I thought the day might come when I, too, 
would be brought to tears upon hearing 
their cheers."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If that directly leads to my speed, then 
it's not a bad result at all."

Her experience at the Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival seemed to have provided Agnes 
Tachyon with a great deal of stimulation.
